title: Can Generalist Vision Language Models (VLMs) Rival Specialist Medical VLMs? Benchmarking and Strategic Insights
abstract: arXiv:2506.17337v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise in automating image diagnosis and interpretation in clinical settings. However, developing specialist medical VLMs requires substantial computational resources and carefully curated datasets, and it remains unclear under which conditions generalist and specialist medical VLMs each perform best. This study highlights the complementary strengths of specialist medical and generalist VLMs. Specialists remain valuable in modality-aligned use cases, but we find that efficiently fine-tuned generalist VLMs can achieve comparable or even superior performance in most tasks, particularly when transferring to unseen or rare OOD medical modalities. These results suggest that generalist VLMs, rather than being constrained by their lack of specialist medical pretraining, may offer a scalable and cost-effective pathway for advancing clinical AI development.

translated_title: 通用视觉语言模型（VLMs）能否与专业医学VLMs相媲美？基准测试与战略见解
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLMs）在临床环境中自动化图像诊断和解释方面展现出潜力。然而，开发专业医学VLMs需要大量的计算资源和精心策划的数据集，并且目前尚不清楚在何种条件下通用型与专业型医学VLMs各自表现最佳。本研究强调了专业医学VLMs和通用VLMs的互补优势。专业模型在模态对齐的使用场景中仍然有价值，但我们发现，经过高效微调的通用VLMs在大多数任务中可以达到甚至超越专业模型的性能，尤其是在迁移到未见或罕见的分布外（OOD）医学模态时。这些结果表明，通用VLMs并不受限于缺乏专业医学预训练，反而可能为推进临床AI发展提供一条可扩展且成本效益高的路径。
tldr: 本文发现高效微调的通用视觉语言模型在多数任务中可媲美甚至超越专业医学VLMs，尤其在罕见或未见医学模态上，为临床AI提供更经济可扩展的路径。
en_tdlr: This study finds that efficiently fine-tuned generalist VLMs can match or surpass specialist medical VLMs in most tasks, especially on unseen or rare medical modalities, offering a scalable and cost-effective path for clinical AI.
